o.text: From Proto-Turkic *gēč. Related to Azerbaijani gecə (“night”) and Azerbaijani keçmək (“pass”). Cognate with Turkish geç (“late”), Chuvash каҫ (kaś, “night, evening”).
From Arabic مُعْتَبَر (muʕtabar). Compare Turkish muteber.
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *sedrek (“gappy, rare, perforated”), from *sedre-. Cognate with Kazakh сирек (sıyrek), see more cognates there.
